theme: Light mode primary for dashboard with dark mode fallback. Use high contrast, authoritative aesthetic.

typography.installation: Update index.css to import fonts from Google Fonts: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chivo:wght@300;400;700;900&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

colors.strategy: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST. Authority, Clarity, Truth.
colors.instructions: Update index.css HSL variables to match these stark, high-contrast hex values.

visual_enhancers.surface: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border/60. Use border-collapse for tables and bento grids.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain sharp, institutional authority. No large soft corners.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove default soft shadows. Use sharp 1px solid borders or hard offsets if needed. shadow-none on cards.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). High contrast. Hover state must invert or darken explicitly.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight border darken, no lift.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. Square edges. Label uppercase tracking-widest.
components.tables: Dense rows. Grid lines visible. Use Shadcn Table. Strict alignment.
components.badges: Square borders. Signal colors for statuses (Active, Pending, Alert).
components.dialogs: Solid background, hard border. No glassmorphism.

layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layouts.spacing: Generous external padding, dense internal data. p-6 or p-8 for main containers.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar or top nav with hard bottom/right border. No transparency. Active state indicated by a hard left border line (3px).
layouts.scan_page: Mobile-first, high contrast (dark mode enforced for scan page to reduce glare). Massive camera viewfinder, clear large buttons.

motion.interactions: Minimalist. Hover states change background/border color instantly or 0.15s ease. No bouncy animations.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders with sharp edges. No spinning circles, use linear progress bars.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Normal text min 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-scan-btn').

image_urls.login_background_description: White modern cement building under blue sky. Use as full screen background with heavy dark or light overlay.

media.treatment: Images must be stark. Avatar placeholders should be monochromatic or desaturated if real images aren't present. For the login background, use a 70% opacity overlay to ensure form contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Indonesian correctional facility (lapas) monitoring dashboard. The language MUST be full Bahasa Indonesia.
Implement the UI with Shadcn components but override their styles to be flat, sharp (rounded-none), and high-contrast. Remove all default Vercel-like soft shadows and radiuses.
Apply ARCHETYPE 4 (SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST) rules. The UI should look like a digitized technical ledger.
For the scanner page, ensure it is mobile-first, using a dark theme context or high contrast, so operators can use it in varying lighting.
Use lucide-react for all icons. Do not use emojis.
Every interactive element MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Do not use generic 'transition: all'. Apply explicit transition properties.
The header and navigation must have solid backgrounds. Do not use transparent backgrounds.
Do not center-align layouts by default. Left-align data and text. Center only if it improves visual rhythm.
Use sonner for toast notifications. Include robust error and success feedback for the operator scanning flow.
Ensure the QR barcode generator uses high contrast logic and the export functionalities are prominent in the UI.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, BUT NOT for data-dense security dashboards. Stick to solid backgrounds.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (in this context, sharp, technical buttons).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js/tsx
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Role-based clarity: Ensure Admin, Supervisor, and Operator views are distinctly laid out according to their core tasks.
Mobile operator view: The scanning flow must be thumb-friendly and highly legible outdoors or in poor lighting.
Audit log readability: Use tabular data with strict monospace fonts for timestamps and user IDs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
